title: ID0368272-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2 / R6 313065117075] Temperature values is very high
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
Temperature values is very high. That's why charging is interrupted
[BT1-T=40.8|BT2-T=29.7|BT3-T=37.8|BT4-T=53|BT5-T=28.4]
You can see the screenshot from log at the attachment.
Root cause: BT4 Faulty
Solution: BT4 replaced
On DAMEX Sanctioned List: Siemens Employee

Problem Description
: Temperature values is very high
Troubleshooting
:
We have analysed the logs,
And We are suspecting, Wires of the Humidity and the temperature wire of the BT1 Sensor are swapped.
But, Still we suggest to have a spare BT1 sensor.
Also. Do let us know, When are you planning for the Site intervention.
We need to check for the continuity as highlighted in the Schematic.
